<script lang="ts">
	import * as Sidebar from "$UI$/sidebar/index.js";
	import { cn, type WithElementRef } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import type { HTMLAttributes } from "svelte/elements";

	// The sub navigation of a settings area. Ported from the shadcn-svelte settings dialog block (sidebar-13): a
	// Sidebar.Provider with a non collapsible Sidebar.Root, so it can sit inside a page that has its own sidebar.
	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		width = "13.75rem",
		children,
		...restProps
	}: WithElementRef<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>> & {
		/** Width of the nav, any CSS length. Twenty uses 220px. */
		width?: string;
	} = $props();
</script>

<Sidebar.Provider class="min-h-0 w-auto items-stretch" style="--sidebar-width: {width};">
	<Sidebar.Root
		bind:ref
		collapsible="none"
		data-slot="settings-nav"
		class={cn("hidden border-r md:flex", className)}
		{...restProps}
	>
		<Sidebar.Content>
			{@render children?.()}
		</Sidebar.Content>
	</Sidebar.Root>
</Sidebar.Provider>

<script lang="ts">
	import * as Item from "$UI$/item/index.js";
	import { cn, type WithElementRef } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import type { HTMLAttributes } from "svelte/elements";

	// A label and a description on the left, a control on the right, built from Item.
	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		title,
		description,
		children,
		...restProps
	}: WithElementRef<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>> & {
		title: string;
		description?: string;
	} = $props();
</script>

<Item.Root bind:ref data-slot="settings-row" size="sm" class={cn("px-0", className)} {...restProps}>
	<Item.Content>
		<Item.Title>{title}</Item.Title>
		{#if description}
			<Item.Description>{description}</Item.Description>
		{/if}
	</Item.Content>
	<Item.Actions>
		{@render children?.()}
	</Item.Actions>
</Item.Root>

{title} {#if description} {description} {/if}
{#if actions}
{@render actions()}
{/if}
